name: ProxyAI
description: JetBrains IDE plugin with AI chat that applies diffs, next-edit predictions, autocomplete and commit message generation.
whatItDoes: ProxyAI adds an AI assistant to IntelliJ-family IDEs. Developers can chat about code and have the changes applied automatically, get completions and edit predictions, and generate commit messages. It can also search the web for context.
howItWorks: The plugin is written in Kotlin and runs inside the IDE, sending requests to the configured cloud or self-hosted model. Chat responses are converted into diffs applied to the open files. Normal users install it from the JetBrains Marketplace; the README documents running a development IDE from source.

requirements.name: JetBrains IDE
requirements.description: The plugin runs inside IntelliJ-based IDEs

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Needed for hosted providers; self-hosted models are also supported

models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Mistral and self-hosted models
